description_en: Sends an SMS message from the platform
name: SendMessage

parameters.help_en: The custom task name. The name cannot contain special characters and can be up to 40 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义任务名称，不能包含特殊字符，最长40个字符
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SMS template. You can view the template ID in the console
parameters.help_zh: 短信模版编号，可以在控制台查看
parameters.name: message_template_id

parameters.help_en: The replacement dynamic parameter for an SMS message, in the format {1}{2}
parameters.help_zh: 动态参数短信，替换的参数，格式{1}{2}
parameters.name: message_variable_param

parameters.help_en:
The timestamp, in seconds.

If the specified time is earlier than the current time, the message is sent immediately. If the specified time is later than the current time, the message is sent at the scheduled time.

The scheduled time cannot be more than one month from the current time
parameters.help_zh:
时间戳，单位：秒 。

当时间早于当前时间则立即发送，晚于当前时间为定时发送。

最晚不能超过一个月
parameters.name: message_send_time

parameters.help_en: The list of destination MSISDNs to which the SMS message is sent
parameters.name: msisdns

Code.description_en:
The response code.

200: The call was successful.

Other codes: The call failed. For more information, see error codes
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

200：调用成功。

其他：调用失败。错误码详情，请参见错误码

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the address was added. Valid values:

true: The address was added.
false: The address failed to be added
Data.description_zh:
地址是否添加成功。

true：添加成功。

false：添加失败

DynamicMessage.example: 入参不能为空，或不能包含空格

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

LocalizedMessage.description_en: The error message displayed in the language of the current region
LocalizedMessage.description_zh: 根据当前所在地展示对应语言的错误提示

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. An identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。 false：调用失败
